_readme: Plugin-id ownership record. Plugin ids are first-come and permanent:
this file is what makes that machine-checkable, so .github/workflows/
validate-index.yml can tell 'the author is updating their own listing'
from 'someone is taking over an id that is not theirs'.
Shape: `owners` maps a plugin id (the same id as in index.json, matching
^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,39}$) to a non-empty list of GitHub handles, WITHOUT
the leading @, compared case-insensitively. Any listed handle may submit
changes to that plugin's entry; list more than one for co-maintainers or
- every id in index.json has an entry here with at least one handle
- every entry here that is not in index.json is fine (a reserved or
delisted id stays claimed — ids are never recycled)
- the PR author must be an owner of every entry they add or change
- a maintainer adds the owners.json line for a brand-new plugin in the
same PR; that addition is the curation step, reviewed by a human
